cases.title: Valid login + OTP succeeds
cases.actionSteps: 1) Go to provider.govectora.com/login 2) Enter valid email/password 3) Submit 4) Enter 6-digit OTP 5) Submit
cases.expected: Dashboard loads with 4 status cards and charts

cases.title: Invalid password rejected
cases.actionSteps: 1) Enter valid email + wrong password 2) Submit
cases.expected: Inline error; no OTP step reached

cases.title: Invalid OTP rejected
cases.expected: Error shown; access denied; "Didn't receive it?" resend control present

cases.title: Session sign-out
cases.expected: Returns to login; protected routes unreachable

cases.title: Provider credentials blocked from Admin panel
cases.expected: Access denied — separate auth realm/tenant claim

cases.title: Collapsible sidebar
cases.expected: Sidebar collapses/expands; nav links accessible in both states

cases.title: Status cards render
cases.actionSteps: 1) Observe Total Active Drivers, Compliant Personnel, Compliance Expiring Soon, Non-Compliant Personnel
cases.expected: All 4 cards render with correct labels/period (Today / Next 30 days)

cases.title: Trips Overview chart (last 7 days)
cases.expected: Mon–Sun bars with Completed/In Progress/No Show/Cancelled legend render without error

cases.title: Today's Trip Statistics empty/populated state
cases.expected: Shows "No trips today" or live breakdown; "Updated just now" / "Every minute" refresh label present

cases.title: Payout Disputes panel
cases.expected: Shows "No disputes yet" or disputes grouped by status

cases.title: Payout Overview chart (last 30 days)
cases.expected: Date axis (Aug 15 – Sep 9 style rolling window) and $ axis render without error

cases.title: Drivers list scoped to this provider
cases.expected: Only drivers linked to this provider shown; 8 columns: Name, Status, Phone, License #, License Expiry, Compliance Status, Documents, Assigned Trips

cases.title: Add Driver form (observe only, do not submit)
cases.actionSteps: 1) Open Add Driver 2) Inspect required fields
cases.expected: Form opens; do not save

cases.title: "My Requests" sub-tab
cases.expected: Shows this provider's submitted request history (Driver Change Request type per Admin Request SLA config)

cases.title: Export controls
cases.expected: Completes without error

cases.title: Column visibility (8/8 indicator)
cases.expected: Toggle available per column; count indicator updates (e.g. 7/8)

cases.title: Monitors list scoped to this provider
cases.expected: Only monitors linked to this provider shown

cases.title: Add Monitor form (observe only)
cases.expected: Form opens; do not save

cases.title: Compliance summary tiles
cases.expected: Tiles render (0/0/0/0 in test tenant — "no drivers or monitors linked yet")

cases.title: Document upload entry point (observe only, do not upload)
cases.preconditions: Compliance page, a linked driver/monitor exists (data-dependent)
cases.expected: Upload control present for each required document type
cases.regr: No — data-dependent, no linked personnel in test tenant

cases.title: Recent reminders table
cases.expected: Table columns Date/Subject/Recipient/Docs/Status render (empty state acceptable)

cases.title: Compliance thresholds match Admin config
cases.actionSteps: 1) Compare "Expiring Soon" window to Admin Settings Compliance Thresholds
cases.expected: Same 30-day/7-day windows apply as Admin/Client Portal

cases.title: Active Trips scoped to this provider's drivers
cases.expected: 8 columns: Trip ID, Passenger, Driver, Monitor, Route, Start Time, Duration, Status; only this provider's trips shown

cases.title: Future Trips read-only
cases.expected: No dispatch/status-change action available (today-only dispatch rule)

cases.title: Trips History
cases.expected: Past trips listed, read-only

cases.title: Export controls
cases.expected: Completes without error

cases.title: Payouts list scoped, empty state
cases.expected: 5 columns: Payout Date, Period, Amount, Status, Reference #, Download; empty rows acceptable in test tenant

cases.title: No money-movement controls present
cases.expected: Explicitly states "Saved for your records only — Vectora does not move money through these details"

cases.title: Add payout method (observe only, do not submit)
cases.expected: Form opens; do not save

cases.title: Driver Payouts sub-tab
cases.expected: Per-driver payout breakdown renders, scoped to this provider

cases.title: Statements sub-tab
cases.expected: Renders without error

cases.title: Disputes sub-tab
cases.expected: Renders without error; matches Dashboard "Payout Disputes" panel data

cases.title: All 8 report sub-tabs render
cases.actionSteps: 1) Open Performance, Trips, Earnings, Drivers, Monitors, Vehicles, Compliance, Incidents in turn
cases.expected: Each renders without error, scoped to this provider

cases.title: Period selector
cases.actionSteps: 1) Change Period (e.g. This week → custom range) 2) Reset
cases.expected: Data reflows to selected period; Reset restores default

cases.title: Messaging entry point
cases.expected: Message center opens, scoped to this provider's conversations

cases.title: Notifications scoped
cases.expected: Only this provider's/user's notifications shown

cases.title: Dark/light mode toggle
cases.expected: Switches instantly; persists

cases.title: No cross-provider data leakage
cases.actionSteps: 1) Inspect all rows across Drivers, Monitors, Trips, Payouts, Compliance
cases.expected: Every row belongs to this portal user's own `service_provider_id` — none from other providers

cases.title: Read-only roster parity with Admin
cases.preconditions: Compare this portal's Drivers list to Admin's Settings → Service Provider Portal Users roster (Admin plan VCTR-ADM-110 range)
cases.expected: Data is consistent between the provider's own view and Admin's read-only roster

cases.title: Help link
cases.expected: Contextual help content loads without error
